_instructions.about: Add your conference abstracts, posters, and talks here. The page renders this automatically — no HTML edits needed.

fields.year: Year of presentation (number, used for grouping)
fields.title: Full title of the abstract or poster
fields.authors: Author list. Wrap your name in **double stars** to bold it, e.g. **John V**
fields.highlight: true = green left border (use for first-author or featured work)
fields.note: Optional extra context, e.g. 'First-author poster presentation'
fields.url: Optional link to the abstract or poster PDF — omit the field if not available
